# Entra Extensions Manager v1.0.0

## Feature overview

Entra Extensions Manager is a browser-only portal for managing Microsoft Entra extension data using delegated Microsoft Graph permissions. This first release includes:

- Schema extension management
- Directory extension management
- Open extension management (per object)
- Usage and audit visibility tooling
- Guided UX features for safer and faster admin workflows

## Self-hosted deployment (no build required)

1. Download `entra-extensions-manager-v1.0.0.zip` from this release.
2. Extract the ZIP.
3. Open `config.js` and replace placeholder values with your Entra app registration values.
4. Upload all extracted files to your static web host (Azure Static Web Apps, GitHub Pages, S3/CloudFront, nginx, etc.).
5. In Entra app registration, ensure your final hosted HTTPS URL is added as a **Single-page application (SPA)** redirect URI.
6. Browse to the hosted site and sign in.

## Package contents

The release ZIP contains everything needed for self-hosting:

- Built static app files from `dist/`
- `config.js` placeholder template
- `README.md`
- `LICENSE`
- `staticwebapp.config.json`
- `.env.example` (reference values)

## Configuration guide

Edit `config.js`:

```js
window.__EEM_CONFIG__ = {
  aadClientId: "__VITE_AAD_CLIENT_ID__",
  aadTenantId: "__VITE_AAD_TENANT_ID__",
  aadRedirectUri: "__VITE_AAD_REDIRECT_URI__",
};
```

Replace:

- `aadClientId` with your Entra application (client) ID
- `aadRedirectUri` with your deployed HTTPS origin
- `aadTenantId` is kept for compatibility

## Browser compatibility

- Microsoft Edge (latest stable)
- Google Chrome (latest stable)
- Mozilla Firefox (latest stable)
- Safari (latest stable)

JavaScript must be enabled.

## System requirements

- A modern browser with HTTPS access to Microsoft sign-in and Graph endpoints
- Microsoft Entra ID app registration configured for SPA auth (PKCE)
- Static web hosting for the extracted files

## Required permissions

Delegated permissions required by the portal:

- Microsoft Graph: `User.Read`, `Application.Read.All`, `Directory.Read.All`, `AuditLog.Read.All`, `Application.ReadWrite.All`, `Directory.ReadWrite.All`
- Azure Service Management: `user_impersonation` (for tenant switcher membership lookup)

Admin consent is recommended for tenant-wide operations.

## Security and privacy

- Browser-only design: no backend service processes tenant data.
- Authentication uses delegated user context; the app cannot exceed granted user/admin permissions.
- No tenant data persistence by the application itself.
- Do not share access tokens or sensitive tenant data in support channels.
